items.evidence: vitest AC#1 passes. The test covers the preflop opening state (seat 3 to act; seat 5 tries 7 action shapes) and the flop (3 shapes), with a seat-3 check as the control. Each check uses deepFreeze, a JSON snapshot, strict result shape, toStrictEqual against a clone and a legal follow-up. Mutants for out-of-turn code, mutating the action and precedence were killed. Holdout: every other seat 0..12 (including undealt) with 7 action shapes, a heads-up river, and 20k random states all gave out-of-turn with an unchanged state. A finished hand plus a wrong seat gives hand-complete (precedence).

vitest AC#2 passes. The test covers the listed raise and bet amounts, a 500-run fast-check property, the after-a-raise state, the BB option and the raise-8 control. Mutants accepting any raise amount or a preflop bet were killed. Holdout: integer sweep -50..200 for raise, bet and call at the opening state. Only raise 8 and call 4 are accepted. Fractional, string, null, undefined, -Infinity and MAX_VALUE amounts, a missing amount, a stray amount on fold, a check facing a bet and an unknown type are all rejected with illegal-action and leave the state unchanged. A short-stack seat's unaffordable raises are rejected.

vitest AC#3 passes. The test asserts the preflop and turn caps with legalActions exactly [fold, call 16] and rejects the listed raise totals. The accept-capped-raise mutant was killed. Holdout: flop and river caps reject every tried raise total, and no raise is offered at the cap. At betCount 3 a raise is still accepted (boundary).

vitest AC#4 passes. The test covers the unbet flop (first actor and a later checker) and the BB option, with check accepted as the control in each. The accept-fold-unfaced mutant was killed. Holdout: heads-up BB option plus first and second actor on the flop, turn and river all reject fold with illegal-action and leave the state unchanged.

vitest AC#5 passes in about 4.2 s under coverage (<10 s NFR). The test asserts exactly 100,000 injections, the per-kind minimums, hand-complete injections and accepted legal follow-ups. The seed is deterministic (recorded deviation, sound). All input-mutation mutants (including mutate-then-undo) were killed. Independent holdout with a different seed: 20,008 random reachable states (2-10 seats, stacks 5..200). In each one, every type x ~25 amounts not in legalActions was rejected with illegal-action and a JSON-identical frozen state, and every legal pick was accepted. Total 3,313,622 checks, 0 failures.
